hypothesis: CL is the dominant WTI information book and should alone define the post-maintenance gap. MCL's lower-liquidity opening print is attribution, not a veto; matched MCL must instead confirm CL's completed fifteen-minute acceptance or failure relative to its own pre-maintenance close before it may transport the direction.

frozen_auction.reference: last completed five-minute CL/MCL close before NYMEX maintenance
frozen_auction.gap_direction: sign of the first post-maintenance CL open minus prior CL close; zero excluded
frozen_auction.mcl_open_gap: recorded as aligned/opposed/zero attribution only; cannot veto or choose direction
frozen_auction.verdict: after exactly three completed five-minute bars, CL and MCL closes must both remain on CL's gap side for acceptance or both cross the opposite side for failure
frozen_auction.direction: follow dominant CL gap acceptance; fade dominant CL gap failure
frozen_auction.frequency: maximum one event per Globex session
frozen_auction.weekend: included and explicitly attributed; contract-roll sessions excluded

frozen_order: reconstruct exact completed pre-maintenance and first-three post-maintenance bars
exclude contract rolls, incomplete auctions, and zero CL gaps
let dominant CL define the gap while recording MCL open disagreement only as attribution
require completed CL and MCL agreement on acceptance or failure relative to their own prior closes
count both periods independently before any forward return
if_eligible: Preregister one branch-aware lifecycle with next-open MCL entry, semantic prior-close/gap invalidation and hard session/contract/gap flat; discovery must pass before validation opens.
prohibitions: no CL or MCL gap magnitude, MCL opening-parity selector, ATR normalization, alternate verdict clock, partial bar, volume, flow, VWAP, retained state, news, stop distance, target, timeout, cooldown, replacement, or quota
no outcome, MFE, MAE, PnL, validation economics, order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
unseen runtime parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL spread, liquidity, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
